message.content: Proposed 4 changes — review the inline preview, then Accept or Reject.

patch.title: Anonymize the manuscript for double-blind review: replace author name/affiliation with "Anonymous", remove the institution-specific acknowledgment, and mask the self-citation (rewording + renaming bib key our2023→anon2023).

hunks.oldText:
\section*{Acknowledgments}
We thank the Northlake University laboratory.
The results use the public Atlas dataset and retain the necessary self-citation \cite{our2023}.
hunks.newText: The results use the public Atlas dataset and cite prior work \cite{anon2023}.
